verdict.rationale: Brave Search API is a key-authenticated HTTP API, so it can be called headlessly. The docs show plain curl requests and an official n8n community node for automation workflows, and an official MCP server lets agents call it programmatically. No first-party docs cover CI pipelines, secret handling for API keys in CI, or headless/non-interactive usage guidance, so coverage of the story is partial. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions or secrets setup), an official CLI for scripted use, independent hands-on corroboration of CI/automation usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Get your API key and make your first request in minutes.
This guide covers the steps to enable Brave Search via the official Brave Search community node in n8n.io, a flexible and community-driven automation platform.
